title: Even-level Fourier weight of odd majority
statement: Let $n$ be an odd positive integer, and let $k$ be an even nonnegative integer. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of the majority function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, over all subsets of coordinates of size $k$, is zero.
